source_context: GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the explicit CyclotomicField 8 Q realization from the accepted discriminant-tower roadmap. The contribution constructs the generators zeta+zeta^7 and zeta-zeta^7, proves their quadratic relations, establishes irreducibility of X^2-2 and X^2+2 via Eisenstein at 2, packages the resulting degree-two intermediate fields, proves their supremum is the full eighth cyclotomic field and hence linear disjointness, records the ambient degree/discriminant invariants, and computes the signed discriminants 8 and -8 of the canonical rational power bases. The later ring-of-integers transport needed to close loadBearing_of_witness is intentionally left for a subsequent contribution.
